consigne: Cherche chaque exercice au brouillon avant d'ouvrir le corrigé.

corrige: Introducteur au passé → backshift : am → was.

exercices.enonce: Complète avec say ou tell : He ___ me that he was leaving.
corrige: Il y a un complément de personne (me).
He **told** me that he was leaving.
exercices.reponse: He told me that he was leaving.

exercices.enonce: Rapporte : "I will help you," he said to me.
corrige: He said he **would** help me. / He told me he would help me.
exercices.reponse: He told me (that) he would help me.

exercices.enonce: Rapporte la question : "Where do you work?" she asked.
corrige: Question ouverte : on garde le mot interrogatif « where ».
Ordre affirmatif, pas de « do », backshift → worked.

exercices.enonce: Rapporte la question fermée : "Are you tired?" he asked.
corrige: Question oui/non → introduite par « if » (ou whether).
exercices.reponse: He asked if I was tired.

exercices.enonce: Rapporte : "I have lost my keys," she said.
corrige: She said she **had lost her** keys.
exercices.reponse: She said she had lost her keys.

exercices.enonce: Rapporte : "I saw him here yesterday," he said.
corrige: saw → had seen ; here → there ; yesterday → the day before.
He said he **had seen** him **there the day before**.
exercices.reponse: He said he had seen him there the day before.

exercices.enonce: Corrige : « He asked me where did I live. »
corrige: Dans une question rapportée, on rétablit l'ordre affirmatif.
On supprime « did » et on applique le backshift.
exercices.reponse: He asked me where I lived.

exercices.enonce: Rapporte : "Do you like coffee?" she asked me.
corrige: Question fermée → « if » ; ordre affirmatif, pas de « do ».
exercices.reponse: She asked me if I liked coffee.
